name: ledger
description: A durable, id'd record of the questions an agent asks the human (one-word answers, optional ceiling) and the notes it records when it decides without asking, in one SQLite file. A CLI the agent runs, batch pastes applied line by line, and opt-in per-folder hooks that inject the open items at session start, deny AskUserQuestion until the question has a row and git push until the session has a note, refuse once a turn that asks with no row or decides with no note, and apply answers typed into a prompt. Every hook fails open.
